# Editable

> Text that is edited in place, such as a title or a name: a button showing the value that becomes an input when pressed.

`<slab-editable>` · Form · built on `<button> + <input>`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/editable/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/editable.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-editable label="Title" name="title" value="Footing pour"></slab-editable>
```

Until it's pressed, it's a button showing the value, named by the label and then the value, so it reads as "Job name, 14 Alder Lane". Clicking it, or its label, starts editing, with the text selected so typing replaces it. Enter keeps what's typed and Escape discards it, and both put focus back on the button. Moving focus away keeps it too, so a click elsewhere or a Tab doesn't lose an edit.

`value` is what was last committed, and it's what the form gets under `name`. It doesn't change while the input is typed into, only when an edit is committed, and that's when "input" and then "change" are dispatched, as a native `<select>` dispatches them, if the value is different. The `value` attribute is the default, which a form reset goes back to. `edit()`, `commit()` and `cancel()` do what the keys do, and `editing` says which is showing.

While it's empty, the button shows `placeholder`, and `:state(empty)` styles it. A field that's disabled while it's being edited stops, and what was typed is discarded. For a field that's always an input, use [Text Field](text-field.md).

It's never invalid on its own. For a rule of your own, such as a name that can't be empty, call `setCustomValidity()` with a message from its "change" listener. It shows in `::part(validity-message)`, and the host matches `:state(error)`, once validity is reported, as on [Text Field](text-field.md): when focus leaves, when its form is submitted, or on `reportValidity()`.

## Keyboard

| Key          | What it does                                                         |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Enter, Space | On the button, starts editing, with the text selected.               |
| Enter        | In the input, keeps what's typed and goes back to the button.        |
| Escape       | In the input, discards what's typed and goes back to the button.     |
| Tab          | In the input, keeps what's typed and moves on, as a click away does. |

## Elements

### `<slab-editable>`

Import `slab-elements/editable.js` to register it.

Text that's edited in place, such as a title or a name: a native button showing the value, that becomes a native input when it's pressed.

The button is named by the label and the value, so it reads as "Job name, 14 Alder Lane". Clicking it, or pressing Enter or Space on it, starts editing, with the text selected. Enter commits what's typed and Escape discards it, and both put focus back on the button. Moving focus away commits it too, so a click elsewhere or a Tab doesn't lose it.

`value` is what was last committed, and it's what the form gets under `name`. It doesn't change as the input is typed into, only when an edit is committed, which is when "input" and "change" are dispatched, one after the other, as a native `<select>` dispatches them.

It's never invalid on its own. For a rule of your own, such as a name that can't be empty, call `setCustomValidity()` or `setValidity()`, from "change" for one that depends on the value. The validity message shows in its description, as on Text Field, once validity is reported: when focus leaves it, its form is submitted, or `reportValidity()` is called.

Style it through its parts and through `:state(disabled)`, `:state(editing)`, `:state(empty)` and `:state(error)`. While it's empty, the button shows `placeholder`.

#### Attributes

| Name               | Type      | Default | Description                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------ | --------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label` (required) | `string`  |         | Names it. It's the accessible name, and the visible label where there is one.                                                                        |
| `disabled`         | `boolean` | `false` | Disables it, as `disabled` does a native control: the user can't focus or use it, and a form control's value isn't submitted.                        |
| `editing`          | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the input is showing rather than the button. Setting it doesn't move focus. `edit()` does.                                                   |
| `hide-label`       | `boolean` | `false` | Hides the label visually and leaves it as the accessible name, for a design that shows the label some other way.                                     |
| `maxlength`        | `number`  |         | The most characters the user can type, as a native input's `maxlength`.                                                                              |
| `name`             | `string`  | `''`    | The name its value is submitted under, as a native control's `name`.                                                                                 |
| `placeholder`      | `string`  |         | Shown on the button while it's empty, and in the input.                                                                                              |
| `value`            | `string`  | `''`    | Like a native input, the attribute is the default value and the property is the current one, so the attribute doesn't change as edits are committed. |

#### Properties

| Name                            | Type                      | Description                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `form` (read-only)              | `HTMLFormElement \| null` | The form it belongs to, or `null`.                                                                                                    |
| `validationMessage` (read-only) | `string`                  | What's wrong, as the validity message says it: the message given to `setCustomValidity()` or `setValidity()`. Empty while it's valid. |
| `validity` (read-only)          | `ValidityState`           | Its `ValidityState`, as a native control's.                                                                                           |
| `willValidate` (read-only)      | `boolean`                 | Whether its validity is checked when its form submits. It isn't while it's disabled or read-only.                                     |

#### Methods

| Signature                                                         | Description                                                                                                                   |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cancel(): void`                                                  | Stops editing and discards what's typed.                                                                                      |
| `checkValidity(): boolean`                                        | Whether its value is valid. Dispatches "invalid" when it isn't, as a native control's does.                                   |
| `commit(): void`                                                  | Stops editing and keeps what's typed.                                                                                         |
| `edit(): Promise<void>`                                           | Starts editing and focuses the input, with its text selected.                                                                 |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`                             | Focuses it, or the part of it that takes focus.                                                                               |
| `reportValidity(): boolean`                                       | Whether its value is valid. When it isn't, dispatches "invalid" and shows the validity message, as a native control's does.   |
| `resetValidityFeedback(): void`                                   | Clears the validity feedback without changing `validity`.                                                                     |
| `setCustomValidity(message: string): void`                        | Makes it invalid with a message of your own, or valid again with an empty one, as a native control's does.                    |
| `setValidity(flags?: ValidityStateFlags, message?: string): void` | Sets its validity and message, as `ElementInternals.setValidity()` does, for checks of your own beyond `setCustomValidity()`. |

#### Events

| Name      | Type    | Description                                                                                                                                                            |
| --------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `input`   | `Event` | When an edit that changes its value is committed, just before "change", as a native `<select>` dispatches it. Not as it's typed, since `value` only changes on commit. |
| `change`  | `Event` | When the user changes its value, as a native control's does. Setting it from code doesn't dispatch it.                                                                 |
| `invalid` | `Event` | When a check finds its value invalid, as a native control's does. Cancel it to leave the validity message unshown.                                                     |

#### Slots

| Name          | Type                | Description                                                                                                 |
| ------------- | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `description` | `Element \| string` | Text that describes it, such as a hint or what the validity message means. It's its accessible description. |

#### CSS parts

| Name               | Description                                                    |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `description`      | Text about the field, and its validity message when it has one |
| `input`            | The input                                                      |
| `label`            | The label                                                      |
| `preview`          | The button, while not editing                                  |
| `validity-message` | The validity message, which says why the value is invalid      |

#### CSS states

| Name               | Description                                                                                                               |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:state(disabled)` | While it's disabled.                                                                                                      |
| `:state(editing)`  | While it's being edited.                                                                                                  |
| `:state(empty)`    | While it has no value.                                                                                                    |
| `:state(error)`    | While it's invalid and its validity message shows, which is once its validity is reported, as when its form is submitted. |
